message: v10.10.13 moves Update Center from Finance to Settings, fixes English/German localization in update and game-health UI, removes stale v10.0.2 release information, and keeps the v10.10.11-v10.10.12 Model Lab interaction, immediate-model-refresh and smooth-scroll fixes. The Windows bootstrap now checks this GitHub manifest before launch and falls back to its last known-good local build if the update check or download fails.
